summary: OCI delivery needs a registry auth secret: create an auth.json with base64 `username:password` for registry.redhat.io (a registry service account token) and create a secret named `<deployment-name>-dynamic-plugins-registry-auth`, such as `developer-hub-dynamic-plugins-registry-auth`, in the RHDH project.
questions: How do I create the dynamic-plugins-registry-auth secret?
What should the RHDH registry auth secret be named?
How do I base64 encode registry credentials for auth.json?

answer_card.title: Registry auth secret for OCI plug-in delivery
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
# auth.json
# {"auths": {"registry.redhat.io": {"auth": "<base64 of user:password>"}}}
printf '%s' '<username>:<password>' | base64

oc create secret generic <deployment-name>-dynamic-plugins-registry-auth \
  --from-file=auth.json=./auth.json   # e.g. developer-hub-dynamic-plugins-registry-auth
oc get secret <deployment-name>-dynamic-plugins-registry-auth
```
Create it in the RHDH project **before** configuring the plug-ins, using a registry service account token (not personal credentials). With Podman logged in you can use `${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR}/containers/auth.json`.
